newsitem.title: FRANCE: Nice air cargo traffic up 7.9 pct in September.
newsitem.headline: Nice air cargo traffic up 7.9 pct in September.

text.p: Nice-Cote d'Azur airport reported a 7.9 percent increase in airfreight traffic last month on September 1995 with throughput reaching 1,517 tonnes, airport authority figures showed.
Since mid-September 1996, United Parcel Service, has operated a weekday Lyon-Nice cargo feeder rotation using a two-tonne capacity Beechcraft 1900 aircraft.
Cargo throughput totalled 12,898 tonnes, down 10.7 percent on 1995 levels.
The Air France group generates the major part of cargo traffic handled at Nice Airport.
Apart fron the new UPS feeder flight, the only other freighter flight at the airport is a DHL Worldwide Express weeknight stopover as part of its intra-European air cargo network.
Postal traffic was up 7.9 percent on 1995 levels at 6,539 tonnes.
French airline L'Aeropostale carries overnight mail between its Paris-Charles de Gaulle hub and Nice on a regular basis using Boeing 737QC aircraft.
